command: python -I -B scripts/pad_anet_comparison.py trial --attempt 1 --i-am-authorized --checkpoint-root <a folder outside the repository>
cap_unit: minutes of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)

accepted_card.rule: the shared-history rule of the project (nuaa_patience_verify.shared_history, criteria.shared_history_difference = 0 of nuaa_patience_verify.json): the five values of each of the first 3 epochs identical, difference 0, no tolerance, computed with one source, pad_arch_comparison.history_differences (a non-finite value, NaN or infinite, in the compared epochs stops the trial as FAIL with no outputs); per field the first epoch at which the two values differ (first_differing_epoch), the largest absolute difference (max_abs_difference) and the first epoch at which it is reached (epoch_of_max_abs_difference) are reported; in PR #29 the field first_differing_epoch held the epoch of the largest difference (our defect, corrected with a test on 19 November 2026)
accepted_card.consequence: the outcome is recorded and does not change the status of the trial; it is the first check of the copy of the trainer; in the plan the same check is repeated on every epoch of every one of the 24 LivenessNet trainings (against the accepted run at the same patience); if the history is not reproduced in the trial, the difference is reported and the pre-registration is not closed before it is explained

control_rule: LivenessNet is trained first, with the same trainer, as a control of the machine and threads (not one of the three trials): the five quantities of epochs 1-3 must be identical, difference 0, to the accepted card arm_b_fold1_seed42 and to the C2 trial 20261119-ARCHTRIAL-b8f7cca, and the machine and versions equal, field by field, to those of the C2 trial (the rule of pad_arch_run.machine_rule, recorded); otherwise the outcome is CONTROL_FAILED

card.checkpoint: none saved by the trainer (the caller saves it)

training.checkpoint: weights of the epoch with minimum val_loss on the dev frames (EarlyStopping restore_best_weights; set_weights when the epochs end first)
training.loss: CategoricalCrossentropy, one-hot labels (index 0 bona fide, 1 attack)
training.class_weight: balanced on the fitting set: n / (2 * n_class)
training.augmentation: RandomFlip(horizontal), RandomRotation(0.03), RandomZoom(0.12, 0.12), RandomTranslation(0.06, 0.06), RandomBrightness(0.15, value_range=(0, 1)), RandomContrast(0.2), GaussianNoise(0.02); fitting set only
training.seeds: train_seed for random, numpy and TensorFlow (weight initialisation, augmentation, batch order); no split seed: the folds and the samples are deterministic

test_read: no test frame is assembled or evaluated and no test score or metric of the new trainings is read, computed or written. check-inputs and trial read what pad_arch_comparison.load_inputs reads (its TEST_READ: the five M2 manifests, the cache hashed whole with its label and subject members read, the extracted frames file loaded whole with the SHA-256 of every frame, the cells run, the folds run, the configurations, status.json and restricted SHA256SUMS of the two accepted LivenessNet runs and the card arm_b_fold1_seed42 of the run at patience 4; the fold schema is never loaded); in addition this configuration, the configuration of the pre-registration of C2, the configuration of PR #27 (for its tolerances and BN settings), the code files pinned here and the status.json and trial.json of the official C2 trial. check-inputs, trial, plan and check-plan read the public status.json and results.json of the C2 evaluation (published files; results.json holds the aggregated C2 test results, already known: it is parsed and only its list of the 48 checkpoints, with run, network, fold, seed and checkpoint SHA-256, is used); no restricted file of the C2 runs or of the C2 evaluation and no <model>_test_scores.csv is opened. trial, in addition: the image arrays of the cache, loaded whole into the frame store; of all the frames it assembles only the fitting and dev frames of arm B, fold 1 (an explicit check refuses any other role); it reads back its own checkpoints, written outside the repository. plan and check-plan read also, if given, the status.json and trial.json of a trial of this code

declarations.no_test: no test frame is assembled or evaluated and no test score or metric of the new trainings is read in this step; the only trainings are the 3-epoch trials on the fitting and dev frames of arm B, fold 1, seed 42
declarations.already_known: the NUAA test and the C2 results are already known (C2 evaluation 20261121-ARCHEVAL-332fbdf, pull request #32); the LivenessNet and ResNet-18 cells of this comparison are those cells, reused
declarations.not_independent: on NUAA this comparison is not an independent validation
declarations.post_hoc: the C5 design was written after the C2 contrast was seen (+9.98 points of ACER): a post hoc extension to three more networks
declarations.technical_trial: 3 epochs per network, patience 4, seed 42, NUAA arm B fold 1, fitting 1,400 and dev 400 frames; LivenessNet first as a control of the machine, not counted among the three trials
declarations.cpu_only: CPU only, GPU hidden and the remapping optimizer off (nuaa_folds_run.hide_gpu), as in C2
declarations.checkpoints: the three trial checkpoints are saved outside the repository, an unofficial output: only their names and SHA-256 enter the record
declarations.threads: 10 intra-op and 10 inter-op TensorFlow threads, set and read back by the runner (pad_arch_comparison.set_threads), as in C2
